rationale_md: Switzerland enters this Group B encounter as narrow favorites, backed by a 120-point Elo rating advantage over the hosts Qatar. The model sees this as essentially a three-way toss-up, with the Swiss holding just a four-percentage-point edge in win probability over Qatar, while a draw remains a substantial possibility at one-quarter odds. That rating gap suggests Switzerland possesses superior quality, but not enough to make them overwhelming favorites in what promises to be a competitive group stage clash.
